author: LegitGod
quote: For the first six hours, you are essentially trapped in an overly scripted interactive movie. Between the heavy, sluggish character animations and endless, hand-holding tutorial missions, it takes forever just to feel like you're actually allowed to play the game. Even when the map finally opens up, the pacing constantly hits a brick wall. You're repeatedly forced to pause the main story to grind out repetitive side jobs just to **** together enough cash to unlock the next mission.
